programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E49 Náufragos Alex y Fernando sufren un accidente y quedan varados en una isla. Roberto sospecha que Raquel espera un hijo de Ulises.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E50 Reflexiones de vida Alex y Fernando reflexionan sobre sus vidas y tratan de buscar la manera de salir de la isla. Bruno, al sentirse descubierto, se hace la víctima con Victoria para que no lo exponga ante los abogados.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E51 Artimañas Bruno decide no impugnar el testamento por petición de Victoria. María José sospecha que Bruno mató al abogado. Bruno le pide a Ulises que se case con Raquel.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E52 Estrategia ganada La impugnación del testamento se lleva a cabo sin la presencia de Alex y todo se complica cuando se enteran de que Alex y María José se divorciaron y que él le cedió toda su fortuna.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E53 Repartición de bienes Alex y Fernando son rescatados de la isla. Elena le pide ayuda a Ulises para encontrar a Sandra. Maura le propone a María José comprar las acciones que le dejó Alex. Bruno trata de tomar la presidencia de la empresa.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E54 El regreso del buen hijo Alex regresa a su casa e impide que María José le venda las acciones a Maura. Elena por fin descubre dónde se ha estado quedando Sandra. Victoria organiza una cena con toda la familia para anunciar el regreso de Alex.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E55 Peleando el territorio Bruno se pelea con Fernando para impedir que entre a casa de Victoria. Sandra busca rehabilitarse de su adicción a las drogas.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E56 Hijos negados Raquel no quiere tener a su hija y Roberto le propone divorciarse a cambio de quedarse con la niña. Sandra se da cuenta de que su tarjeta fue cancelada y se pone en contacto con Elena para exigirle dinero. Alex decide venderle las acciones a Maura.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E57 Gemela perdida Ulises viaja a la Ciudad de México para encontrarse con Sandra, pero después de encontrarla ella vuelve a desaparecer. Alex descubre una fotografía de Sandra y le pregunta a Pedro si María José tiene una hermana gemela.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E58 Ira descontrolada Bruno amenaza a Pedro para que María José le dé su voto para la presidencia. Alex descubre más información en torno a Sandra. Roberto le confiesa a Raquel que tuvo algo que ver con Ulises y ella lo apuñala. Bruno termina con Katia.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E59 Ataque sorpresivo Alex y Victoria protegen a Raquel para que la policía no la culpe por el atentado contra Roberto. María José ignora las amenazas de Bruno y vota por Alex para que siga en la presidencia. Bruno ataca a María José y ella comienza con labor de parto.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E60 Vida y muerte El hijo de María José nace sin problemas. Ulises encuentra a Sandra inconsciente en un hospital de la ciudad. La policía busca a Pedro para arrestarlo. Ulises le propone a Elena hacer pasar a María José como Sandra.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E61 Amenazas cumplidas Victoria le propone a María José hacerse cargo de su nieto. Paula se pone mal al saber que la policía ya ha trasladado a Pedro a la cárcel.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E62 Adicciones Pedro es golpeado en la cárcel por uno de los reos. Victoria teme que Raquel vuelva al vicio del alcohol.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E63 Celos incontrolables Ulises idea un plan junto con Elena para secuestrar al bebé de María José. Maura enfurece al saber que Alex planea casarse con María José. María José llora al saber que Pedro ha sido golpeado en la cárcel.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E64 Tristes noticias Fernando despide a Katia de la empresa al saber que es cómplice de Bruno. Victoria se pone mal al saber que Alex y María José no vivirán con ella después de la boda.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E65 Amor prohibido Jorge y Elena tratan de convencer a Maura de unirse a ellos para deshacerse de María José. Fernando le pide a Victoria que no oculten más su amor. Victoria decide terminar su relación con Fernando.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E66 Esplendida noticia Alex le da la noticia a Victoria de que Pedro podría salir de la cárcel. Bruno y Maura llevan a cabo sus planes para deshacerse de María José.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E67 Secuestro Jorge secuestra a María José y planea desaparecerla. Victoria se preocupa al saber que María José fue secuestrada.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E68 Llanto incontrolable Alex llora desesperado al saber que María José fue secuestrada. Fernando le confiesa a Victoria que Lisette tiene leucemia. Porfirio se pone feliz al saber que por fin conocerá a su nieta.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E69 Una nueva identidad Bruno se cambia el nombre para que María José no lo reconozca. Maura comienza a enamorar a Alex ahora que María José no está.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E70 Malas noticias Felipa le aconseja a Victoria que retome su relación con Fernando. Raquel decide divorciarse de Roberto. Maura decide donarle su médula ósea a Lisette para salvarle la vida. Elena se pone mal al saber que Sandra ha muerto.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E71 En mal estado María José entra en estado de coma. Pedro se pone mal al saber que María José ha quedado en coma. Maura le confiesa a Alex el amor que aún siente por él. Alex descubre que la mujer internada en el hospital no es María José.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E72 Evidencias Alex se pone feliz al saber que María José está viva. Damián le confiesa a Sandra el amor que siente por ella. Alex descubre que Elena es la responsable del secuestro de María José.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E73 Amor robado Elena intenta convencer a Sandra de que se case con Damián. Alex descubre el escondite donde tienen encerrada a María José.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E74 Dolor inmenso Alex enfurece al ver cómo Bruno besa a María José. A Pedro se le rompe el corazón al saber que Sandra está en coma.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E75 Recordando el amor María José comienza a recordar su pasado. Alex pasa tiempo con María José para volver a conquistarla.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E76 Exigencias Pedro, Alex y Paula incineran a Sandra. María José cuestiona a Elena sobre su pasado. Jorge le exige a Bruno que enamore a María José. Fernando le cuenta a Emiliano sobre su relación con Victoria.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E77 Buenas intenciones Raquel se emociona al saber que tendrá la custodia de su hija. Paula convence a María José de pasar un día entero con Alex. Alex logra llevar a María José a su casa para poder ayudarla a recuperar la memoria.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E78 Consejos Bruno, Elena y Jorge idean un plan para acusar a Alex de secuestro. Chucho le aconseja a Pedro que rescate a María José de Elena.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E79 Enfrentamiento Alex descubre cuál fue la causa de la pérdida de memoria de María José. Alex idea un plan para que Jorge confiese la fórmula de sanar a María José. Damián y Elena llegan a la casa de Victoria para llevarse a María José lejos.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E80 Un pasado por descubrir Maura le entrega a Bruno el video donde se ve a Katia con otro hombre. La enfermera le cuenta a María José la verdad sobre su pasado.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E81 Gran esperanza Bruno idea un plan para deshacerse de María José. Los doctores le afirman a María José que jamás fue drogadicta y que tuvo un bebé.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E82 Miedos Maura teme que María José recupere la memoria y la acuse de complicidad con los secuestradores. Victoria le deja en claro a Bruno que María José jamás lo amará.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E83 Dolorosa verdad Lisette le promete a Letty pagar su operación contra la leucemia. Elena se pone mal al saber que María José ha recuperado la memoria. Fernando sufre un terrible accidente.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E84 Trágica muerte Fernando es llevado al hospital para evitar que quede paralítico. Fernando le confiesa a Alex que Mateo es el culpable del accidente. Raquel descubre a Ulises muerto en su departamento.

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: S01E85 Buscando culpables La policía comienza la investigación para saber quién mató a Ulises. Bruno es el principal sospechoso sobre la muerte de Ulises.

programme.desc: S01E114 Agradecimiento sincero Oriana le dice a Teresa que Arturo vendió su casa y que Fernando la compró para Luisa. Teresa le agradece a Mariano por salvarle la vida. El parto de Esperanza se adelanta porque Rubén la alteró con su visita.

programme.title: Teresa
programme.desc: S01E110 Amor al borde de la muerte Héctor opera a Teresa y logra estabilizarla. Aída le reclama a Mariano por preocuparse por la salud de Teresa. Mariano termina con Aída porque nunca va a poder amarla.

programme.title: Teresa

programme.title: Teresa
programme.desc: S01E111 Horrible verdad Arturo le pregunta a Héctor si es verdad que Teresa podría quedar cuadripléjica y él se lo confirma. Aurora le cuenta a Héctor que se casará con Martín. Aída va a ver a Teresa al hospital y le dice que está paralítica.

programme.title: Teresa
programme.desc: S01E115 Mentiras al descubierto Oriana escucha los reclamos que Cutberto le dice a Teresa por haber sido una mala mujer con Mariano. Hernán le pide a Esperanza se case con ella y formen una familia.

programme.title: Teresa
programme.desc: S01E116 Una nueva vida juntos Teresa comienza sus planes para comenzar a enamorar a Fernando. Esperanza y Hernán se casan en el hospital para comenzar una nueva vida juntos.

programme.title: Teresa
programme.desc: S01E117 Una verdad bastante cruel Mariano le muestra a Aída el bebé de Esperanza y le pide comprenda que él no es el causante de los errores de Rubén. Oriana le confiesa a Arturo los engaños de Teresa.

programme.title: Teresa
programme.desc: S01E118 Dolor engañoso Arturo enfrenta a Teresa y le reclama por sus engaños. Aída le deja en claro a Aurora que luchará por el amor de Mariano y se enfrentará a quién sea para conquistarlo.

programme.title: Teresa
programme.desc: S01E119 Venganza de amor Arturo planea vengarse de Teresa y para ello le cuenta a Fernando los planes que tiene para que ella se sienta miserable a su lado. Teresa enfurece al saber que Oriana es la responsable de que Arturo desconfíe de ella.

programme.title: Teresa
programme.desc: S01E120 Compromiso terminado Martín decide romper su compromiso con Aurora al saber que no lo ama. Arturo planea alquilar el departamento de Chonita para regresar a Teresa a vivir a la vecindad.

programme.title: Teresa
programme.desc: S01E122 Burlas Teresa se pone celosa al enterarse de que Mariano está interesado en Aurora. Oriana y Aída se presentan en la vecindad para burlarse de Teresa.

programme.title: Teresa
programme.desc: S01E123 Planes de seducción Teresa comienza a idear un plan para lograr que la boda de Fernando se cancele. Fernando le exige a Arturo que saque a Teresa de la vecindad.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E02 Mr. Earp Meets a Lady Earp tries to reduce the possibility of violence when fellow marshal Bat Masterson romances a woman whose boyfriend is an outlaw.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E03 Bill Thompson Gives In Earp resists forming a posse and instead uses American Indian scouts in his efforts to locate a killer.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E04 Marshal Earp Meets General Lee Cowboys believe that the townspeople of Ellsworth insulted Confederate Army Gen. Robert E. Lee.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E05 Wyatt Earp Comes to Wichita When Earp takes over as marshal of Wichita, his first challenge is a local group of vigilantes focused on lynching a local card dealer, despite evidence that the man acted in self-defense.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E06 The Man Who Lied A man bent on revenge pays a gunman $1,000 to kill Wyatt Earp -- a gunman who claims to have faced Earp before.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E07 The Gambler Earp is blamed when the saloon owner's crooked games are exposed and the man is shot in the back.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E08 The Killer Dave Bennett, angry when Earp kicks him out of Wichita after a crooked card game, hires a killer to take out the marshal and make the town suffer.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E09 John Wesley Hardin Hardin comes to Wichita seeking revenge against Earp for throwing Dave Bennett out of town.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E10 The Bank Robbers A double cross and an outlaw's wife lead Wyatt to a gang of bandits.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E12 The Big Baby Contest Smart gamblers and dubious rules hamper Wyatt's efforts to run a contest.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E13 Frontier Journalism Was Fearless A courageous newspaperman makes a stand when gamblers attempt to force the mayor to get rid of Marshal Earp.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E14 Trail's End for a Cowboy The childish son of a rancher, forced to sell a herd for less than he'd planned, tries to make up his losses in a poker game.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E15 Rich Man's Son The young son of a railway executive runs away, hoping to become a ranch hand and carry a gun.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E16 The Buntline Special A brash visitor arrives in Wichita and, hoping to convince Earp to join a Wild West show, offers the lawman a new gun that will become his trademark.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E17 Ben Thompson Returns Earp's habit of using sanitation laws to shut down saloons where crooked games are played begins to anger the saloon owners, who send men after the marshal.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E18 Marshal Earp Plays Cupid The woman who catches Earp's eye is in love with a man who needs Earp's protection from a gang of cattle thieves.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E19 The Assassins When Earp sends a crooked gambler packing, three saloon owners decide they've had enough and hire gunmen to take Earp out.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E21 Mr. Cousin and Mr. Brother Earp is called in to rescue a pair of Indians being held hostage by a renegade who's been selling guns to members of various tribes.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E22 The Bribe Murdock to call for Earp's badge when it appears that a crooked gambler got a saloon license by bribing the marshal.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E23 The Frontier Theatre Earp closes down an all-girl show when the underpaid women begin stealing from the audience, earning Earp the ire of the show's owner, who plots revenge.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E24 Killing at Cowskin Creek Someone is targeting big winners from the Keno House as they leave town, and Earp is determined to put a stop to it.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E25 The Englishman An angry ex-gang member who hates Earp tries to take advantage of a visiting Englishman, but finds himself facing off against both men.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E26 The Desperate Half-Hour Earp arrests the Kansas Kid, accused of robbery, murder, and wounding a deputy, but Earp is not convinced of the man's guilt or the sheriff's intentions.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E27 The Necktie Party Ranchers are frustrated by the number of horse thefts near Wichita and want to blame a band of gypsies camped on Gus Cassen's property.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E28 One of Jesse's Gang A pillar of the community is hailed as a hero when he shoots a thief, until people learn that the man is wanted for being a member of the James gang.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E29 The Pinkertons Allen Pinkerton, hoping to recover stolen money, interferes in Earp's investigation of a murder in Wichita and gets the judge to pull Earp's badge.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E31 Hunt the Man Down Earp must enter the rough Bushwhacker region to find a man suspected of murder, but his behavior once found leads Earp to believe the man is not guilty of the crime.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E33 Bat Masterson Again Earp tries to help an old friend, Bat Masterson, who is working as an Army scout and being threatened by a killer.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E01 Wichita Is Civilized Earp must defuse a conflict between warring families after Ollie and Mildred Taylor set up shop in Wichita and become targets of a man angry at Ollie's cousin for killing his brother; tensions escalate into a deadly struggle, then a lynch mob.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E02 Dodge City Gets a New Marshall Earp becomes the new marshal of Dodge City and immediately finds himself fighting off gunmen working for the Big T gang; determined to bring order to the city, Earp gathers local support as the gang holds the sheriff of Ford County under siege.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E03 Fight or Run Uneasy city council member Jim Kelley must choose a side to support when the council becomes deadlocked on the passage of new laws to give Earp more power, and members of the Big T gear up to attack Dodge City.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E04 The Double Life of Dora Hand Constant brawling between railroad workers and buffalo hunters threatens to close Dora Hand's dance hall for good; when the conflict intensifies into a full-scale assault on the railroad, Earp and Dora race to intervene.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E05 Clay Allison A businessman eager to end Earp's war on crime asks notorious gunman Clay Allison to kill him; after Kelley warns Earp about the gunman's skill, Earp uses psychological tactics to gain the upper hand.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E06 Wyatt's Love Affair A judge's daughter pines for Earp, who shares her feelings but doubts a relationship can endure his life as a lawman; two local outfits cause trouble for Earp after he arrests their leaders, culminating in a fight between Earp and their foreman.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E07 A Quiet Day in Dodge City Earp must keep a tight lid on problems in Dodge City while a journalist from New York pays a visit, but the job proves especially difficult on a chaotic day filled with dog fights, gunfire and rowdy cowboys.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E08 The Almost Dead Cowhand When a disgruntled cowhand holes up in a warehouse, Earp investigates the man's experiences in Dodge City to understand what drove him to violence and uncovers a chain of abuse perpetrated by underhanded citizens.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E09 The Reformation of Jim Kelley When Dora Hand convinces Jim Kelley to sell his saloon in advance of their marriage, McGuire and Albright wrangle a deal to make Earp part-owner of the saloon without his knowledge and frame him for illegal business practices.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E10 So Long, Dora, So Long Aggressive suitor Bob Rellance pesters Dora on the day before her marriage to Kelley, asking her to call off the wedding in favor of himself, but when tensions escalate into violence, Earp steps in to force Rellance out of town.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E11 Bat Masterson Wins His Star Bat Masterson travels to Dodge City and gets involved in a gunfight that causes him to lose Earp's approval; after befriending gang member Nellie Wright, Bat tries to get word to Earp about an upcoming robbery but ends up at the gang's mercy.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E12 The Lonesomest Man in the World A newly deputized Bat complicates an arrest by shooting perpetrator Billy Jordan after Billy ran out of bullets; while Earp and the deputies race to find a surgeon, Billy's family holds Bat hostage and threatens to take revenge if Billy dies.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E13 Take Back Your Town With Earp and Bassett out of town, George Morris' gang sacks Dodge City and rounds up all the remaining deputies except for Bat, who finds Earp and sneaks back into town to fight the gang with the help of local residents.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E14 Nineteen Notches on His Gun Earp and Bat pose as outlaws to infiltrate a gang involved in a rash of murders and cattle thefts, staging a power struggle within the gang and setting up an ambush in Dodge City to take down the entire group.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E15 The Hanging Judge Earp must get Judge Tobin to see the error of his ways when the judge sentences an innocent man to death by hanging, going to extreme lengths to turn the tables by framing the judge for a crime.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E16 Justice Two men wanted by a Cheyenne tribe for murder seek refuge in Dodge City, and although Earp arrests the pair, the city refuses to press charges because the victims were Indians.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E17 Shootin' Woman A poor rancher woman struggling to marry off her daughter deals with trespassers trying to steal her land's resources and rumors that she has gold on her property.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E19 Wyatt and the Captain After an altercation between a drunk soldier and a Cherokee civilian results in death, Earp takes the soldier into custody and fights off his captain's attempts to free him.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E20 Witness for the Defense Men from the Circle Bar ranch kidnap Ben Thompson, a dealer who cheated them at cards, and Earp poses as a doctor to gain access to the ranch and free Ben.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E21 The Sharpshooter A crippled man with a grudge against Earp hires sharpshooter Rule Hawes to kill him; Bat and the other deputies search for the assassin while Annie May tries to give Bat a clue.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E22 Siege at Little Alamo Wells Fargo hires Earp to protect a gold shipment arriving by stage at Little Alamo and the marshal must work with the stagecoach passengers to hold out against the Curly Bill Brocius gang until a posse can arrive to save them.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E23 Vengeance Trail Fred Colby, a man wrongly sent to prison, finishes his sentence and heads for Dodge City looking for the man who killed his brother.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E24 Command Performance While Earp and Buffalo Bill stage a fake robbery to entertain a visiting German prince, real bandits kidnap the prince and hold him for ransom.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E25 They Hired Some Guns Earp and Bat find their careers in jeopardy when they arrest the owners of two competing stagecoach companies whose hired armies threaten to start a war in the streets.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E26 Bat Masterson for Sheriff Earp and Bat work together to help Bat win an election for county sheriff to defeat Jerry Lanphere, a crook also running for the position; Sen. Drew tells Bat he must end his friendship with Earp to gain the people's favor.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E27 Hang 'Em High Earp has 24 hours to find a killer after a judge sentences an innocent man to hang, but the man refuses to speak in his own defense, leaving Earp with few clues to follow.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E28 The Vultures Bounty hunters stir up trouble in Dodge City by trying to collect rewards on reformed outlaws until Earp devises a plan to turn the bounty hunters against each other.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E29 Young Guns A headstrong teenager named Jimmy Craig arrives in Dodge City and wants to become one of Earp's deputies, demonstrating his impeccable skill with a gun, but his dream contrasts sharply with his irrational obsession to duel Ed Beatty.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E30 The Nice Ones Always Die First Earp takes Bat's brother Ed under his wing as a new deputy, but while Ed believes outlaws can be reasoned with, Bat knows better; two businessmen plan to kill Ed and frame Bat for the crime to secure ownership of a saloon.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E31 Old Jake When buffalo hunter Jake Caster arrives in Dodge City and an Army sergeant dies from an apparent Indian attack soon after, Earp investigates the tragedy that claimed the life of Jake's wife and child.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E32 The Equalizer Earp tries to help gun repairman Guns McCallum deal with his temper by summoning his wife to Dodge City; when Guns admits he can't repair a gunslinger's favorite sidearm, he finds himself in a deadly showdown.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E33 Wyatt Meets Doc Holliday Doc Holliday, the gunslinging dentist, teams up with Earp to stop a gang of train robbers; Doc's wife, Kate, insists upon taking him to a hospital to receive treatment for consumption, but Earp can't take the gang alone.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E34 Beautiful Friendship Earp tries to resist pressure to throw Doc out of Dodge City, but when the dentist commits murder in the street, Earp throws him in jail and faces the ire of Doc's wife, Kate; Doc comes to Earp's rescue when a gang captures the marshal.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E35 Dull Knife Strikes for Freedom Earp must negotiate with Chief Dull Knife when a Cheyenne tribe launches an attack to retake their ancestral lands, hoping to avoid a confrontation with Maj. Benteen's soldiers.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E36 The Gold Brick When Doc purchases a gold brick from a wanted thief and then sells it to prove a point, Earp follows the brick's trail as it passes through the hands of various Dodge City residents.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E37 The Wicked Widow After a rancher receives threats to stop courting widow Myra Malone, Earp pays a visit to Myra, who refuses to trust the law after northern troops killed her husband, and finds her sheltering a wanted woman connected to a gang.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E38 They Think They're Immortal Earp reluctantly agrees to hire his younger brother Morgan as a deputy when Morgan stops a robbery; Morgan assists Deputy Hal when Curly Bill Brocius holds up a stagecoach.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E39 The Time for All Good Men Doc, Bat and several reformed outlaws team up to rescue Earp when the men of the Big T trap him in an abandoned cabin, leading to a desperate and deadly confrontation.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E01 Call Me Your Honor Earp agrees to resign to help Jim Kelley's chances at winning the mayoral election, but the replacement marshal soon faces a crisis when crooks trap Kelley in his store.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E02 The Big Bellyache While on a fishing trip, Earp and Dr. Fabrique run into henchmen who take them to wealthy baron Shanghai Pierce, who insists upon the doctor's services despite Fabrique's utter hatred of the man.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E03 Pinkytown Earp visits a shanty town that refuses to pay taxes to Dodge City, and Doc informs him that Dodge has no claim to the land; Earp manages to arrange the town's annexation in exchange for a new school, but Mayor Kelley alters the bargain.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E04 Shoot to Kill Earp must keep an eye on two fugitives hiding out at Lucy King's home as he awaits a warrant, but when the public catches on, he has no choice but to risk a confrontation.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E05 Wells Fargo vs. Doc Holliday Earp arrests Doc Holliday and Skunky Groggin for robbing a Wells Fargo stagecoach, but Doc denies involvement and concocts a plan with Earp to rob another stage to find the truth.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E06 Warpath Lt. Clark alerts Earp about a renegade group of Pawnee who attacked him over a shipment of fake guns and becomes their captive when attempting negotiations; Earp must track down the guns' seller before the Pawnee execute Clark.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E07 Hung Jury Reb Thomas stands accused of murdering Dan Bolton, although Earp suspects a frame-up, and despite Judge Tobin's efforts to hold a swift trial, one juror refuses to agree with the others.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E08 Little Pistol Earp and Doc apprehend a girl called Little Pistol, who helped a gang rob Doc's saloon; Doc uses tooth surgery as a pretense to coax the girl into giving up her true identity and the gang's location while Earp fears for her future.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E09 The Magic Puddle Doc Holliday blocks access to an oil pit in a scheme to sell the substance for medical use, stirring up trouble with travelers and causing Kate to side with Earp in finding a solution to the problem before guns start firing.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E11 Fortitude When Earp learns of a plot against his life, he avoids speaking at a convention held in the Dodge City Opera House and increases security, but as pressure builds for him to speak, Judge Tobin and Mayor Kelley wonder if Earp can still do his job.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E12 The Good and Perfect Gift A boy named Benny Burkett attaches himself to Doc Holliday and ends up under the Hollidays' official care after being forced to shoot his abusive father in self-defense; Dr. McCarty delivers news that shakes the newly formed family.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E13 Indian Wife While Dick Melaney and his Cheyenne wife, Laura, visit Dodge City, a lecherous man confronts Laura, forcing her to shoot him; Laura retreats to find protection with her father, a chieftain who wants Dick to kill the man who assaulted her.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E14 Woman Trouble A gang coerces a woman into courting Earp to learn information about a gold shipment they plan to rob, but Bat and Mayor Kelley see through the ruse.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E15 Shadow of a Man When Earp and Bat leave town to arrest train robbers, Hal Norton must wrangle the remaining deputies to deal with numerous problems that spring up in Dodge City while the ever-doubtful Mayor Kelley seeks to replace him.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E16 Bad Woman When the people of Dodge City capture the brother of gang leader Marie Burden in a robbery, Marie confronts Earp, willing to do whatever it takes to free him.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E17 One-Man Army When a newspaper editor drums up anti-Northern sentiment by launching a smear campaign aimed at Earp, the marshal takes a leave of absence to confront a Texas gang working with the editor.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E18 The General's Lady When a scout from the Battle of the Little Big Horn tries to blackmail Gen. Custer's widow, she fears he plans to provide damaging testimony at an upcoming hearing for Maj. Reno; Earp must convince her that her husband was a courageous man.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E19 The Manly Art Unscrupulous businessman Moresby, seeking a way to permanently cripple Earp, convinces a boxing promoter to have his champ beat Earp, but the marshal refuses to take up the challenge until the champ's blatant cheating injures a young man in the ring.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E20 Sweet Revenge Earp begins dating Mrs. Phillips, a widowed seamstress, but fears for her safety as word arrives in Dodge City that a convict Earp helped put away has escaped and wants revenge.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E21 The Imitation Jesse James Earp arrests a stagecoach robber who copies the style of Jesse James, but the witnesses refuse to testify, and the robber goes free, leading Earp to enlist the skill of a cheating gambler to set a trap for him.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E22 The Kansas Lily A former Confederate spy asks Earp and Bat to help her escape from her dead brother's gang; Bat develops feelings for the woman, but Earp, doubting her story, obeys a warrant calling for her arrest.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E23 Wyatt Earp Rides Shotgun Earp agrees to escort a stage carrying money for Wells Fargo while Bat, Tom Russell and a posse set a trap for the gang planning to attack it.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E25 Ballad and Truth Tex McKay, a reckless railroad driver, spins tales about his experience and starts fights; when Tex deflects blame for a crash he caused, Earp searches for the truth while Tex's friends go after an innocent man.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E26 The Schoolteacher Earp investigates a stagecoach robbery involving $5,000 in silver dollars and becomes confounded when the driver's account of the incident proves false, and Hal subsequently finds the driver shot to death.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E27 When Sherman Marched Through Kansas The citizens of Dodge City split into groups to either welcome or protest the arrival of a controversial Civil War figure, Gen. William T. Sherman; a concerned woman wants to speak with Sherman about her fiancé, a soldier under his command.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E31 One The Dry Gulch Gang ambushes Earp's Cheyenne agents, killing Mr. Brother; a vengeful Earp stalks the men and confronts one when the killer comes to Dodge City to finish the job on a severely wounded Mr. Cousin.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E32 The Underdog A lovesick artist asks Earp to help him learn to fight when his fiancée's family tries to run him out of town; Earp refuses, but an impressed Doc Holliday decides to try helping the man instead.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E33 Two Having caught one of Mr. Brother's killers, Earp looks for the three still at large, meeting an over-helpful Army lieutenant who hinders his search; one of the killers, disguised as a corporal, tricks a patrol into confronting a group of Cheyenne.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E34 Doc Holliday Rewrites History Earp finds himself caught between Doc Holliday and the rest of Dodge City when Doc begins work on a fabricated history of the city's founders.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E36 Dig a Grave for Ben Thompson Sparks fly when Ben Thompson comes to Dodge City looking for Earp's help with two women whom he promised to marry and discovers a plot on his life.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E37 Four Receiving a tip on the location of the last member of the Dry Gulch Gang, Earp and Bat head to a Texas ranch to fulfill Earp's promise of bringing Mr. Brother's killers to justice.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E38 The Frame-Up Cy Johnson, a cattle driver with a grudge, frames Earp for a $10,000 robbery, but Doc Holliday catches wind of Cy's scheme and helps Earp clear his name and bring the true culprits to justice.

programme.desc: S03E39 My Husband Doc Holliday's bending of the law exasperates the officials of Dodge City; when Doc learns about a plot to murder five ex-gang members and does nothing to prevent it, Earp leaves to confront the killers, and Doc begins to regret his choices.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp

programme.desc: S06E35 Just Before the Battle Wyatt uses a stagecoach robbery to set factions of the Clanton gang against each other.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S06E36 Gunfight at the O.K. Corral Wyatt plans to avoid a shoot-out.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S06E37 The Outlaws Cry Murder Wyatt, Doc and Wyatt's brothers are charged with murder following the gunfight, but Curly Brocius and Johnny Ringo make plans to ambush them at the outlaws' funeral.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E01 Wyatt Earp Becomes a Marshal The career of the famous Western lawman begins after he takes over for the murdered sheriff of Ellsworth, Kan.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E02 Mr. Earp Meets a Lady Earp tries to reduce the possibility of violence when fellow marshal Bat Masterson romances a woman whose boyfriend is an outlaw.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E03 Bill Thompson Gives In Earp resists forming a posse and instead uses American Indian scouts in his efforts to locate a killer.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E04 Marshal Earp Meets General Lee Cowboys believe that the townspeople of Ellsworth insulted Confederate Army Gen. Robert E. Lee.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E05 Wyatt Earp Comes to Wichita When Earp takes over as marshal of Wichita, his first challenge is a local group of vigilantes focused on lynching a local card dealer, despite evidence that the man acted in self-defense.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E06 The Man Who Lied A man bent on revenge pays a gunman $1,000 to kill Wyatt Earp -- a gunman who claims to have faced Earp before.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E07 The Gambler Earp is blamed when the saloon owner's crooked games are exposed and the man is shot in the back.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E08 The Killer Dave Bennett, angry when Earp kicks him out of Wichita after a crooked card game, hires a killer to take out the marshal and make the town suffer.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E09 John Wesley Hardin Hardin comes to Wichita seeking revenge against Earp for throwing Dave Bennett out of town.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E10 The Bank Robbers A double cross and an outlaw's wife lead Wyatt to a gang of bandits.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E12 The Big Baby Contest Smart gamblers and dubious rules hamper Wyatt's efforts to run a contest.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E13 Frontier Journalism Was Fearless A courageous newspaperman makes a stand when gamblers attempt to force the mayor to get rid of Marshal Earp.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E14 Trail's End for a Cowboy The childish son of a rancher, forced to sell a herd for less than he'd planned, tries to make up his losses in a poker game.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E15 Rich Man's Son The young son of a railway executive runs away, hoping to become a ranch hand and carry a gun.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E16 The Buntline Special A brash visitor arrives in Wichita and, hoping to convince Earp to join a Wild West show, offers the lawman a new gun that will become his trademark.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E17 Ben Thompson Returns Earp's habit of using sanitation laws to shut down saloons where crooked games are played begins to anger the saloon owners, who send men after the marshal.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E18 Marshal Earp Plays Cupid The woman who catches Earp's eye is in love with a man who needs Earp's protection from a gang of cattle thieves.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E19 The Assassins When Earp sends a crooked gambler packing, three saloon owners decide they've had enough and hire gunmen to take Earp out.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E21 Mr. Cousin and Mr. Brother Earp is called in to rescue a pair of Indians being held hostage by a renegade who's been selling guns to members of various tribes.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E22 The Bribe Murdock to call for Earp's badge when it appears that a crooked gambler got a saloon license by bribing the marshal.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S01E23 The Frontier Theatre Earp closes down an all-girl show when the underpaid women begin stealing from the audience, earning Earp the ire of the show's owner, who plots revenge.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E04 The Double Life of Dora Hand Constant brawling between railroad workers and buffalo hunters threatens to close Dora Hand's dance hall for good; when the conflict intensifies into a full-scale assault on the railroad, Earp and Dora race to intervene.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E05 Clay Allison A businessman eager to end Earp's war on crime asks notorious gunman Clay Allison to kill him; after Kelley warns Earp about the gunman's skill, Earp uses psychological tactics to gain the upper hand.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E06 Wyatt's Love Affair A judge's daughter pines for Earp, who shares her feelings but doubts a relationship can endure his life as a lawman; two local outfits cause trouble for Earp after he arrests their leaders, culminating in a fight between Earp and their foreman.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E07 A Quiet Day in Dodge City Earp must keep a tight lid on problems in Dodge City while a journalist from New York pays a visit, but the job proves especially difficult on a chaotic day filled with dog fights, gunfire and rowdy cowboys.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E08 The Almost Dead Cowhand When a disgruntled cowhand holes up in a warehouse, Earp investigates the man's experiences in Dodge City to understand what drove him to violence and uncovers a chain of abuse perpetrated by underhanded citizens.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E09 The Reformation of Jim Kelley When Dora Hand convinces Jim Kelley to sell his saloon in advance of their marriage, McGuire and Albright wrangle a deal to make Earp part-owner of the saloon without his knowledge and frame him for illegal business practices.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E10 So Long, Dora, So Long Aggressive suitor Bob Rellance pesters Dora on the day before her marriage to Kelley, asking her to call off the wedding in favor of himself, but when tensions escalate into violence, Earp steps in to force Rellance out of town.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E11 Bat Masterson Wins His Star Bat Masterson travels to Dodge City and gets involved in a gunfight that causes him to lose Earp's approval; after befriending gang member Nellie Wright, Bat tries to get word to Earp about an upcoming robbery but ends up at the gang's mercy.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E12 The Lonesomest Man in the World A newly deputized Bat complicates an arrest by shooting perpetrator Billy Jordan after Billy ran out of bullets; while Earp and the deputies race to find a surgeon, Billy's family holds Bat hostage and threatens to take revenge if Billy dies.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E13 Take Back Your Town With Earp and Bassett out of town, George Morris' gang sacks Dodge City and rounds up all the remaining deputies except for Bat, who finds Earp and sneaks back into town to fight the gang with the help of local residents.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E14 Nineteen Notches on His Gun Earp and Bat pose as outlaws to infiltrate a gang involved in a rash of murders and cattle thefts, staging a power struggle within the gang and setting up an ambush in Dodge City to take down the entire group.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E15 The Hanging Judge Earp must get Judge Tobin to see the error of his ways when the judge sentences an innocent man to death by hanging, going to extreme lengths to turn the tables by framing the judge for a crime.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E16 Justice Two men wanted by a Cheyenne tribe for murder seek refuge in Dodge City, and although Earp arrests the pair, the city refuses to press charges because the victims were Indians.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E17 Shootin' Woman A poor rancher woman struggling to marry off her daughter deals with trespassers trying to steal her land's resources and rumors that she has gold on her property.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E19 Wyatt and the Captain After an altercation between a drunk soldier and a Cherokee civilian results in death, Earp takes the soldier into custody and fights off his captain's attempts to free him.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E20 Witness for the Defense Men from the Circle Bar ranch kidnap Ben Thompson, a dealer who cheated them at cards, and Earp poses as a doctor to gain access to the ranch and free Ben.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E21 The Sharpshooter A crippled man with a grudge against Earp hires sharpshooter Rule Hawes to kill him; Bat and the other deputies search for the assassin while Annie May tries to give Bat a clue.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E22 Siege at Little Alamo Wells Fargo hires Earp to protect a gold shipment arriving by stage at Little Alamo and the marshal must work with the stagecoach passengers to hold out against the Curly Bill Brocius gang until a posse can arrive to save them.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E23 Vengeance Trail Fred Colby, a man wrongly sent to prison, finishes his sentence and heads for Dodge City looking for the man who killed his brother.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E24 Command Performance While Earp and Buffalo Bill stage a fake robbery to entertain a visiting German prince, real bandits kidnap the prince and hold him for ransom.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E25 They Hired Some Guns Earp and Bat find their careers in jeopardy when they arrest the owners of two competing stagecoach companies whose hired armies threaten to start a war in the streets.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E26 Bat Masterson for Sheriff Earp and Bat work together to help Bat win an election for county sheriff to defeat Jerry Lanphere, a crook also running for the position; Sen. Drew tells Bat he must end his friendship with Earp to gain the people's favor.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E27 Hang 'Em High Earp has 24 hours to find a killer after a judge sentences an innocent man to hang, but the man refuses to speak in his own defense, leaving Earp with few clues to follow.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E28 The Vultures Bounty hunters stir up trouble in Dodge City by trying to collect rewards on reformed outlaws until Earp devises a plan to turn the bounty hunters against each other.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E29 Young Guns A headstrong teenager named Jimmy Craig arrives in Dodge City and wants to become one of Earp's deputies, demonstrating his impeccable skill with a gun, but his dream contrasts sharply with his irrational obsession to duel Ed Beatty.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E30 The Nice Ones Always Die First Earp takes Bat's brother Ed under his wing as a new deputy, but while Ed believes outlaws can be reasoned with, Bat knows better; two businessmen plan to kill Ed and frame Bat for the crime to secure ownership of a saloon.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E31 Old Jake When buffalo hunter Jake Caster arrives in Dodge City and an Army sergeant dies from an apparent Indian attack soon after, Earp investigates the tragedy that claimed the life of Jake's wife and child.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E32 The Equalizer Earp tries to help gun repairman Guns McCallum deal with his temper by summoning his wife to Dodge City; when Guns admits he can't repair a gunslinger's favorite sidearm, he finds himself in a deadly showdown.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E33 Wyatt Meets Doc Holliday Doc Holliday, the gunslinging dentist, teams up with Earp to stop a gang of train robbers; Doc's wife, Kate, insists upon taking him to a hospital to receive treatment for consumption, but Earp can't take the gang alone.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E34 Beautiful Friendship Earp tries to resist pressure to throw Doc out of Dodge City, but when the dentist commits murder in the street, Earp throws him in jail and faces the ire of Doc's wife, Kate; Doc comes to Earp's rescue when a gang captures the marshal.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E35 Dull Knife Strikes for Freedom Earp must negotiate with Chief Dull Knife when a Cheyenne tribe launches an attack to retake their ancestral lands, hoping to avoid a confrontation with Maj. Benteen's soldiers.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E36 The Gold Brick When Doc purchases a gold brick from a wanted thief and then sells it to prove a point, Earp follows the brick's trail as it passes through the hands of various Dodge City residents.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E37 The Wicked Widow After a rancher receives threats to stop courting widow Myra Malone, Earp pays a visit to Myra, who refuses to trust the law after northern troops killed her husband, and finds her sheltering a wanted woman connected to a gang.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E38 They Think They're Immortal Earp reluctantly agrees to hire his younger brother Morgan as a deputy when Morgan stops a robbery; Morgan assists Deputy Hal when Curly Bill Brocius holds up a stagecoach.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S02E39 The Time for All Good Men Doc, Bat and several reformed outlaws team up to rescue Earp when the men of the Big T trap him in an abandoned cabin, leading to a desperate and deadly confrontation.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E01 Call Me Your Honor Earp agrees to resign to help Jim Kelley's chances at winning the mayoral election, but the replacement marshal soon faces a crisis when crooks trap Kelley in his store.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E02 The Big Bellyache While on a fishing trip, Earp and Dr. Fabrique run into henchmen who take them to wealthy baron Shanghai Pierce, who insists upon the doctor's services despite Fabrique's utter hatred of the man.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E03 Pinkytown Earp visits a shanty town that refuses to pay taxes to Dodge City, and Doc informs him that Dodge has no claim to the land; Earp manages to arrange the town's annexation in exchange for a new school, but Mayor Kelley alters the bargain.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E04 Shoot to Kill Earp must keep an eye on two fugitives hiding out at Lucy King's home as he awaits a warrant, but when the public catches on, he has no choice but to risk a confrontation.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E05 Wells Fargo vs. Doc Holliday Earp arrests Doc Holliday and Skunky Groggin for robbing a Wells Fargo stagecoach, but Doc denies involvement and concocts a plan with Earp to rob another stage to find the truth.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E06 Warpath Lt. Clark alerts Earp about a renegade group of Pawnee who attacked him over a shipment of fake guns and becomes their captive when attempting negotiations; Earp must track down the guns' seller before the Pawnee execute Clark.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E07 Hung Jury Reb Thomas stands accused of murdering Dan Bolton, although Earp suspects a frame-up, and despite Judge Tobin's efforts to hold a swift trial, one juror refuses to agree with the others.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E08 Little Pistol Earp and Doc apprehend a girl called Little Pistol, who helped a gang rob Doc's saloon; Doc uses tooth surgery as a pretense to coax the girl into giving up her true identity and the gang's location while Earp fears for her future.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E09 The Magic Puddle Doc Holliday blocks access to an oil pit in a scheme to sell the substance for medical use, stirring up trouble with travelers and causing Kate to side with Earp in finding a solution to the problem before guns start firing.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E11 Fortitude When Earp learns of a plot against his life, he avoids speaking at a convention held in the Dodge City Opera House and increases security, but as pressure builds for him to speak, Judge Tobin and Mayor Kelley wonder if Earp can still do his job.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E12 The Good and Perfect Gift A boy named Benny Burkett attaches himself to Doc Holliday and ends up under the Hollidays' official care after being forced to shoot his abusive father in self-defense; Dr. McCarty delivers news that shakes the newly formed family.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E13 Indian Wife While Dick Melaney and his Cheyenne wife, Laura, visit Dodge City, a lecherous man confronts Laura, forcing her to shoot him; Laura retreats to find protection with her father, a chieftain who wants Dick to kill the man who assaulted her.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E14 Woman Trouble A gang coerces a woman into courting Earp to learn information about a gold shipment they plan to rob, but Bat and Mayor Kelley see through the ruse.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E15 Shadow of a Man When Earp and Bat leave town to arrest train robbers, Hal Norton must wrangle the remaining deputies to deal with numerous problems that spring up in Dodge City while the ever-doubtful Mayor Kelley seeks to replace him.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E16 Bad Woman When the people of Dodge City capture the brother of gang leader Marie Burden in a robbery, Marie confronts Earp, willing to do whatever it takes to free him.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E17 One-Man Army When a newspaper editor drums up anti-Northern sentiment by launching a smear campaign aimed at Earp, the marshal takes a leave of absence to confront a Texas gang working with the editor.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E18 The General's Lady When a scout from the Battle of the Little Big Horn tries to blackmail Gen. Custer's widow, she fears he plans to provide damaging testimony at an upcoming hearing for Maj. Reno; Earp must convince her that her husband was a courageous man.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E19 The Manly Art Unscrupulous businessman Moresby, seeking a way to permanently cripple Earp, convinces a boxing promoter to have his champ beat Earp, but the marshal refuses to take up the challenge until the champ's blatant cheating injures a young man in the ring.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E20 Sweet Revenge Earp begins dating Mrs. Phillips, a widowed seamstress, but fears for her safety as word arrives in Dodge City that a convict Earp helped put away has escaped and wants revenge.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E21 The Imitation Jesse James Earp arrests a stagecoach robber who copies the style of Jesse James, but the witnesses refuse to testify, and the robber goes free, leading Earp to enlist the skill of a cheating gambler to set a trap for him.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E22 The Kansas Lily A former Confederate spy asks Earp and Bat to help her escape from her dead brother's gang; Bat develops feelings for the woman, but Earp, doubting her story, obeys a warrant calling for her arrest.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E23 Wyatt Earp Rides Shotgun Earp agrees to escort a stage carrying money for Wells Fargo while Bat, Tom Russell and a posse set a trap for the gang planning to attack it.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E24 Wyatt Fights Bat resigns as sheriff and enters into a partnership with local saloon owner Luke Short, who must fight a takeover attempt by two corrupt businessmen; Earp and Bat request a restraining order to stop the men but face resistance from Mayor Kelley.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E25 Ballad and Truth Tex McKay, a reckless railroad driver, spins tales about his experience and starts fights; when Tex deflects blame for a crash he caused, Earp searches for the truth while Tex's friends go after an innocent man.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E26 The Schoolteacher Earp investigates a stagecoach robbery involving $5,000 in silver dollars and becomes confounded when the driver's account of the incident proves false, and Hal subsequently finds the driver shot to death.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E27 When Sherman Marched Through Kansas The citizens of Dodge City split into groups to either welcome or protest the arrival of a controversial Civil War figure, Gen. William T. Sherman; a concerned woman wants to speak with Sherman about her fiancé, a soldier under his command.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E29 It Had to Happen Bat and Earp's deputies, concerned for their lives, convince Mayor Kelley to issue an order stating Earp must shoot to kill in dangerous situations; an outlaw agrees to assassinate Earp, forcing a deadly confrontation that shakes Earp to his core.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E30 County Seat War Dodge City and Fort Dodge get into a political war when the governor grants a special election to determine the new seat of Ford County; a conflicted Earp reluctantly follows Mayor Kelley's order to stop Fort Dodge from rigging the election.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E31 One The Dry Gulch Gang ambushes Earp's Cheyenne agents, killing Mr. Brother; a vengeful Earp stalks the men and confronts one when the killer comes to Dodge City to finish the job on a severely wounded Mr. Cousin.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E32 The Underdog A lovesick artist asks Earp to help him learn to fight when his fiancée's family tries to run him out of town; Earp refuses, but an impressed Doc Holliday decides to try helping the man instead.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E33 Two Having caught one of Mr. Brother's killers, Earp looks for the three still at large, meeting an over-helpful Army lieutenant who hinders his search; one of the killers, disguised as a corporal, tricks a patrol into confronting a group of Cheyenne.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E34 Doc Holliday Rewrites History Earp finds himself caught between Doc Holliday and the rest of Dodge City when Doc begins work on a fabricated history of the city's founders.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E35 Three Earp and Bat team up with the Texas Rangers to capture the remaining members of the Dry Gulch Gang who killed Mr. Brother, bringing one of the indicted members with them as bait.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E36 Dig a Grave for Ben Thompson Sparks fly when Ben Thompson comes to Dodge City looking for Earp's help with two women whom he promised to marry and discovers a plot on his life.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E37 Four Receiving a tip on the location of the last member of the Dry Gulch Gang, Earp and Bat head to a Texas ranch to fulfill Earp's promise of bringing Mr. Brother's killers to justice.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E38 The Frame-Up Cy Johnson, a cattle driver with a grudge, frames Earp for a $10,000 robbery, but Doc Holliday catches wind of Cy's scheme and helps Earp clear his name and bring the true culprits to justice.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S03E39 My Husband Doc Holliday's bending of the law exasperates the officials of Dodge City; when Doc learns about a plot to murder five ex-gang members and does nothing to prevent it, Earp leaves to confront the killers, and Doc begins to regret his choices.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E01 The Hole Up Earp goes undercover as an outlaw to nab thief and murderer Blackie Saunders, but Blackie's men prevent the two from meeting, leading Earp to find shelter near their camp.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E02 The Peacemaker A gang of outlaws takes advantage of Earp's absence by attacking Dodge City in full force and demanding that Mayor Kelley pay them $20,000 and fire Earp; Earp looks for the fastest way back to town while Shotgun Gibbs lends a hand to stop the gang.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E05 The Mysterious Cowhand Earp rides to Oklahoma in search of a killer who stabbed his cousin Nate and volunteers to join a group of cattle drivers, one of whom owns a knife similar to the murder weapon.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E06 The Gatling Gun Earp and Mr. Cousin must talk to the chief of a Nez Perce tribe and negotiate the return of a stolen Gatling gun; the mission hits a snag when a local militia captures the pair, requiring the tribe to rescue them.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E07 Cattle Thieves Earp struggles to uphold the law while keeping the peace when a strict ban on cattle rustling forces him to arrest rancher Rep Cantwell, triggering a battle between Dodge's most powerful ranchers.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E08 Remittance Man A disgraced Englishman living in Henry Dart's establishment instigates a gunfight with a man he claims to owe money to, but Earp intervenes before anyone gets hurt and resolves to get to the root of the problem.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E09 King of the Frontier When Lazy Q cowboy Miles Breck learns about Ned Buntline's new book naming Earp the "King of the Frontier," he sets up a cowboy contest and bets $10,000 against Earp surviving a shootout.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E10 Truth About Gunfighting Ranch hand Mitch Hallam becomes Earp's newest deputy, seeking to prove his worth and earn the hand of his boss' daughter; he puts his job and his life on the line when he reveals an underhanded scheme being perpetrated by the other workers.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E11 Frontier Woman Earp rides to the scene of a stagecoach robbery and follows tracks to find a woman, the sole survivor of the attack, in shock; Earp must shoot his way out of a cave when the bandits trap him inside with the woman.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E12 Santa Fe War Earp rides into Santa Fe, N.M., to stop a war between two families vying for control of the land, the Finneys and the Grangers; the local sheriff backs the duplicitous Finneys, who created fake land deeds, but Earp finds the real deeds.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E13 Plague Carrier When a mysterious man helps Earp with injured stagecoach passengers, Earp takes him to Dodge City, introduces him to Dr. McCarty and talks him into opening a medical practice; a smallpox outbreak leads to a disturbing suspicion about the new doctor.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E14 Kill the Editor A newspaper editor facing backlash for baseless accusations toward dance hall owner Sally Bascom kills her and frames Earp for the murder; Earp plays along to lure the editor into a trap while Doc Holliday and Gibbs take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E15 Little Brother Doc Holliday's friend holds up a stage carrying Earp's younger brother, Morgan, who finds Doc and tells him what happened; suspecting trouble, Doc and Morgan team up to find his friend and rescue him from a gang without notifying Earp.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E17 A Good Man When a preacher comes to Dodge City to condemn gambling as sinful and disrupts activities in Ganly's saloon, he eventually finds himself drawn into a poker game against Ganly.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E18 Death for a Stolen Horse Earp and Doc Holliday prevent the men of the Bar-W ranch from lynching suspected horse thief Joe Riva; while Earp investigates the true culprit, Doc plans a scheme with Joe's daughter to take the blame off him.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E19 Last Stand at Smoky Hill Rumors of large buffalo herds prompt Bat and a number of hunters to ride out in search of pelts; Earp learns about a roaming tribe of Apache hunters and heads out to warn Bat, but hostilities quickly break out between the groups.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E21 Earp Ain't Wearin' Guns When a Texas gang with a distaste for Northerners causes a ruckus in Dodge City, the leader's daughter convinces Earp to hang up his guns and let his fists do the negotiating.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E22 Bat Jumps the Reservation Bat falls for a woman not knowing her involvement in a mob headed for Wyoming; Earp chases after him, following the trail of stolen cattle and dead lawmen the mob leaves in its wake.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E23 The Truth About Rawhide Geraghty Upon learning that a reputed stagecoach driver feels nervous about his final route before retirement, Earp offers to accompany him and sets up protective measures along the route to keep them out of danger.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E24 She Almost Married Wyatt Earp attempts to free an adopted woman from an abusive family but meets resistance at every turn; with Dodge City officials refusing to help, Earp must resort to finding a cowhand to wed her -- or marry the woman himself.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E25 Horse Race A Cheyenne chief named Bullhead races a pony against Milt Canyon and wins, but in a negotiation following the race, Canyon forces Bullhead into a deadly confrontation, and Earp must bring the chief to trial for murder while holding off a lynch mob.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E27 One Murder - Fifty Suspects Earp and Shotgun Gibbs investigate the poisoning of a reviled loan shark and find many citizens with a motive to want the man dead, including a bank clerk with a large gambling debt.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E28 How to Be a Sheriff Del Mathey, the new, naive sheriff of Ford County, confronts his misconceptions about the position when his attempt to evict squatters from a property results in a hail of bullets.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E29 The Judas Goat Deputy U.S. Marshal Hank Drew presents a plan to catch Rocky Griswold and his gang stealing a gold shipment; Rocky's friend Joan Deming sticks up for the unemployed cowhands, believing that Hank wants to entrap them and win their bounties.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E30 Doc Fabrique's Greatest Case When gang members feed Shotgun Gibbs' mule, Roscoe, a deadly amount of alcohol, Earp sends for Doc Fabrique to treat the animal while he pushes ahead and tracks down the group responsible, but Shotgun's fury imperils the situation.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E31 The Actress The arrival of actress Cora Campbell in Dodge City sparks a rivalry between silversmith Tom Tanner and gunslinger Clay Bronson, but when Tom blames Clay for beating him up in an alley, Earp suspects a different attacker.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E32 Love and Shotgun Gibbs Shotgun Gibbs, smitten with hat merchant Phronsie LaTour, agrees to protect her from a suspicious man; Earp tries to foil a gang's plot to rob the railroad by intercepting the gang leader's informant, said to be a pretty blonde.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E34 Dodge Is Civilized Bat returns to Dodge City to buy the Lone Star Saloon but faces reprisal from rival saloon owner Mike de Graff, who wants to see the Lone Star torn down; fed up with Dodge's shady businesses, Mayor Kelley decides to drive out the saloons entirely.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E35 Little Gray Home in the West Earp decides to settle down on a ranch won by Doc Holliday in a poker game, but upon arriving at the property, the two find a widow terrorized by a gang of neighboring ranchers who murdered her husband and stole her cattle.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E33 The Cyclone A boy warns Earp of a cyclone headed for Dodge City and the town prepares to take shelter, but Earp must catch the boy's dog before disaster strikes.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E36 Kelley Was Irish Mayor Kelley fires Earp for allowing Doc Holliday to go free after killing a man in self-defense, then appoints a new marshal who reveals his crooked nature by seeking protection fees from local saloons and killing one owner for not complying.

programme.title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
programme.desc: S04E37 Arizona Comes to Dodge Earp's brothers, Virgil and Morgan, return to Dodge City to invite Earp to go with them to Tombstone, Ariz.; when the Clanton gang shakes up a hotel and pressures a rancher to settle a debt, things escalate into a brawl.

programme.title: Triunfo del amor

programme.title: Triunfo del amor

programme.title: Triunfo del amor
